name: Jelly Up
author: Addicting Games
description: Jelly Up is a free avoider game. Welcome to the bottom, square. You are a momentum powered super square that is starting at the bottom and trying to get to the top. You're like a shark. You just can't stop. All you can do is move fast and jump at the right time. Level up from one platform together as you move faster and the platforms get shorter. Each platform may or may not have the crucial wall at the end. If it doesn't, your square will automatically bounce off the platform. In order to survive, you'll have to time your jumps and your glides just right to avoid jettisoning off of the edge at light speed. The higher you go fast you'll go. Your speed increases automatically and the platforms begin to shrink. If you wish to win and compete against the real gamers out there you'll have to sharpen your skills and get clicking in this fast-paced jelly based platform jumper.
